work_items.title: Rate limit the public API
work_items.body: Each API key gets a number of requests a minute. Requests over the limit get a `429` at once, with `Retry-After`.

work_items.title: Token bucket for each API key
work_items.comment: The bucket is in `api/limits/bucket.ts`, refilled once a second.

work_items.title: Answer 429 with Retry-After over the limit
work_items.body:
When a key's bucket is empty, answer `429 Too Many Requests` at once, with `Retry-After` set to the seconds until the next token.

Done means the integration tests cover a key over its limit.

work_items.title: Document the limits for API users
Remove the v1 endpoints
work_items.comment: The nightly export still calls them.

work_items.title: Pin the Node version that CI tests against
Dark mode flickers on the first load
work_items.body: The page renders light for a moment before the theme loads.
